title: Duecare Jailbroken Models Wheels
subtitle: v3.16 harness on abliterated Gemma 4 - real not faked proof
description: v3.6 / chat-package 0.2.0 (2026-05-06) — 21-dim rubric (added operational_information_provided + harm_enablement_check), use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename. v3.16 - wheels for the chat-playground-jailbroken-models notebook. Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. Loads dealignai/Gemma-4-31B-JANG_4M-CRACK or mlabonne/Gemma-4-E4B-it-abliterated by default. Demonstrates that the 5-layer harness (Persona / GREP 108 rules / RAG 33 docs / Tools 5 lookups / Online) still produces safe + cited outputs even when the base model has had its refusal layer ablated by the model author. Strongest evidence that the safety lift is harness-driven, not base-model-driven.
